Salary columns come from HRMS Salary Slip previews (structure, payment days / LWP, Additional Salary, package overrides). Gross = HRMS gross + OT. OT Amount = Net OT Hrs (OT − Short) × OT Rate (Basic / 200 × 1.5); Short Bal. is information only. No Pay Amount is already inside DEDUCTIONS / No Pay. Employer columns are statistical (not in net pay). Tax/statutory components are calculated on the final Salary Slip including OT.
